children.value: > Fact From Story: On November 6, Google went to trial with Fortnite maker Epic Games.
> > Fact From Story: Epic hopes to prove that Google engages in anticompetitive behavior with regard to its Android app store, Google Play, and its commission structure.

> > > Fact From Story: Epic argues that Google makes it so difficult for developers and users to get around its Android app store, and that app store’s standard fees, that it’s created an illegal monopoly that unjustly enriches Google while artificially driving up app prices because other stores can’t compete.
> > > Fact From Story: Epic wants to break up Google’s alleged monopoly on Android app stores and payment methods, so developers aren’t stuck paying the “Google Tax” or passing that fee along to you.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: Monopolies are generally considered anticompetitive.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Trials are used to prove allegations of illegal activity.
> Commonsense Knowledge: Trials are formal examinations of evidence before a judge, and often a jury, in order to decide whether someone is guilty of a crime or liable for damages.
